questions.q: How many confirmed aircraft were heard from 26 September to 2 October 2026 (Pacific)?
questions.sql: with s as (select distinct address_type, address from public.pub_sightings where started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')) select count(*) from s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.is_confirmed

questions.q: How many military aircraft were heard from 26 September to 2 October 2026 (Pacific)?
questions.sql: with s as (select distinct address_type, address from public.pub_sightings where started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')) select count(*) from s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.is_confirmed and a.is_military

questions.q: How many aircraft on the FAA LADD list were heard from 26 September to 2 October 2026 (Pacific)? Count confirmed aircraft only.
questions.sql: with s as (select distinct address_type, address from public.pub_sightings where started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')) select count(*) from s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.is_confirmed and a.is_ladd

questions.q: How many sightings were made by aircraft flying JANET callsigns from 26 September to 2 October 2026 (Pacific)?
questions.sql: select count(*) from public.pub_sightings where started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles') and exists(select 1 from unnest(callsigns) c where starts_with(c, 'JANET'))

questions.q: How many different aircraft flew JANET callsigns from 26 September to 2 October 2026 (Pacific)?
questions.sql: select count(distinct address) from public.pub_sightings where started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles') and exists(select 1 from unnest(callsigns) c where starts_with(c, 'JANET'))

questions.q: What was the highest barometric altitude, in feet, reported by the Boeing E-6 Mercury with ICAO address AF1D5B during the week of 26 September to 2 October 2026?
questions.sql: select max(max_altitude_baro_ft) from public.pub_sightings where address = 'AF1D5B' and started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')

questions.q: On which Pacific date (YYYY-MM-DD) was the Lockheed C-5M Galaxy 85-0005 heard during 26 September to 2 October 2026?
questions.sql: select format_date('%F', date(min(started_at), 'America/Los_Angeles')) from public.pub_sightings s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.registration = '85-0005' and started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')

questions.q: What is the registration of the Royal Canadian Air Force CC-150 heard from 26 September to 2 October 2026?
questions.sql: select any_value(a.registration) from public.pub_sightings s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.designator = 'A310' and a.is_military and started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')

questions.q: What was the highest ground speed, in knots, of the Northrop T-38 with registration 64-13301 from 26 September to 2 October 2026? Round to the nearest knot.
questions.sql: select round(max(max_ground_speed_kt)) from public.pub_sightings s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.registration = '64-13301' and started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')

questions.q: How many aircraft registered to Tactical Integrated Training Solutions LLC were heard from 26 September to 2 October 2026?
questions.sql: with s as (select distinct address_type, address from public.pub_sightings where started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')) select count(*) from s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.is_confirmed and upper(a.owner_name) = 'TACTICAL INTEGRATED TRAINING SOLUTIONS LLC'

questions.q: Excluding airlines, which organization had the most aircraft sightings from 26 September to 2 October 2026? Give its name.
questions.sql: with s as (select address_type, address, count(*) n from public.pub_sightings where is_confirmed and started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles') group by 1,2) select coalesce(a.owner_name, a.operator) org from s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where coalesce(a.owner_name, a.operator) is not null and a.aircraft_kind != 'Airline' group by org order by sum(n) desc limit 1

questions.q: How many messages did the receiver record from 26 September to 2 October 2026 (Pacific)?
questions.sql: select sum(message_count) from public.pub_snapshots where bucket_start >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and bucket_start < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')

questions.q: How many different ICAO type designators were flown by military aircraft heard from 26 September to 2 October 2026?
questions.sql: with s as (select distinct address_type, address from public.pub_sightings where started_at >= timestamp('2026-09-26','America/Los_Angeles') and started_at < timestamp('2026-10-03','America/Los_Angeles')) select count(distinct a.designator) from s join public.pub_aircraft a using (address_type, address) where a.is_confirmed and a.is_military
